pos.personaBrief: Flick's Bayern and Barca seek dominance with the ball and win it high (BFW: high line gives more control and possession), but accept vertical transitions (Soccerway: all 4 goals from fast transitions). He does not cede the ball on purpose.

pro.personaBrief: Vertical, quick transitions and long balls behind the high line, yet build-up from the back with the goalkeeper as a +1 (Total Football Analysis) and Kimmich dropping to build (Coaches' Voice).

est.personaBrief: Consistent 4-2-3-1 morphing into a 3-1-4-2 with defined phase structure (Coaches' Voice), with a roaming striker (Lewandowski, Muller) and wingers who switch sides (UEFA).

lar.personaBrief: He likes wingers wide (Football Espana 2024), asymmetrical attack with many crosses from the right for Lewandowski, and wingers switching sides.

blo.personaBrief: Signature very high line, early gegenpressing and pressing the first build-up line (StatsBomb, BFW, UEFA); he loves the risk.

mar.personaBrief: Barcelona defends zonally against Bayern (UEFA); Cubarsi and Inigo coordinate the line by space, and corners are covered by blocks and responsibility.

pla.personaBrief: A recognisable style across clubs, kept despite criticism of the high line; 'we have our philosophy... there can be changes' but the model is imposed on the squad.

res.personaBrief: Proactive, risk-taking attacking football aimed at winning ('it's about winning'); never defensive closing or settling for draws.

sis.personaBrief: Collective pressing system where everyone has duties, with stars like Lewandowski, Muller and Yamal fitted into defined roles; system lifts youngsters like Casado and Davies.

jog.personaBrief: Pace and physical intensity are crucial to the high line and press (Davies, Alaba recovery pace; Flick: physicality as important as technique), with technical ball players in midfield.

bas.personaBrief: Strong trust in youth: Musiala, Zirkzee, Davies at Bayern; 13 La Masia debuts and Casado, Cubarsi at Barca; also won titles with a young XI (24.5 avg).

lid.personaBrief: Positive man-management and respect-based dialogue ('you don't always have to agree with me') while being the clear boss with equal rules.
